How it works

1

Pick your role

Choose your target role and seniority. Paste the job description if you have one. The interviewer preps for it.

Up to 20 minutes of live voice interview. Real questions, natural follow ups, no script in front of you.

3

See what worked and what to fix, with a full transcript. Run it again until the answers feel automatic.

Questions, answered

How realistic is the voice mock interview?

You speak with an AI interviewer in a live voice conversation. It asks questions tailored to your target role and job description, listens to your answers, and asks natural follow ups. Sessions run up to 20 minutes, like a real screening interview.

What does the feedback cover?

After each session you get a scorecard covering communication, answer structure, content depth, and role fit. It highlights your top strength, your most important improvement area, and specific moments from your answers. You also get the full transcript.

Which tools are free?

The interview question generator, resume feedback and rewrite, cover letter generator, and typed mock interview are all free with a JobHackAI account. Every account also includes 1 full voice mock interview.

What happens after my free voice interview?

You see a partial scorecard with your top strength and one improvement area. The full report, transcript, and further sessions require a plan: the Weekly Pass, Monthly, or the Interview Pack.

Can I cancel anytime?

Yes. You can cancel the Weekly Pass or Monthly plan anytime from your billing portal. You keep access until the end of the period you paid for. The Interview Pack is a one time purchase, so there is nothing to cancel.

Do you offer refunds?

If something went wrong with your purchase, email support@jobhackai.io and we will sort it out. Subscriptions can always be cancelled so you are never billed again.

Is my interview data private?

Yes. Your sessions, transcripts, and reports are private to your account. You can export or delete your data anytime from account settings. Payments are processed by Stripe, and we never see your card number.

Does it work on my phone?

Yes. The voice interview runs in the browser on desktop and mobile. No app install. You just need a microphone and a quiet room.
